findings.title: `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` returns supported/allowed abilities when `skipToken` (`undefined`) is passed
findings.body: When `useGrafanaPromRuleAbility` or `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` is called with `skipToken` (for example, in `AlertRuleMenu` and `RuleActionsButtons.V2` when `promRule` is a data source/cloud rule or `undefined`), `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` is invoked with `rule = undefined`. Inside `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, `loading` is `false` and `MaybeSupported` evaluates to `AlwaysSupported` (`true`), so `AlertRuleAction.Duplicate` returns `[true, ctx.hasPermission(rulesPermissions.create)]` and `View`/`Explore` also return `[true, ...]`. Because `AlertRuleMenu` combines abilities with `(duplicateSupported && duplicateAllowed) || (grafanaDuplicateSupported && grafanaDuplicateAllowed)`, any user with `AlertingRuleCreate` permission will see the Duplicate action enabled on all non-Grafana rules (including plugin-provided rules, rules on data sources without Ruler enabled, or external rules where the user lacks `AlertingRuleExternalWrite`). When `rule` is `undefined`, all returned abilities should be `[NotSupported, false]`.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for Grafana rules in the list view because `rule` (`rulerRule`) is `undefined`
findings.body: In the updated list view (`GrafanaGroupLoader` and `FilterView`), `GrafanaRuleListItem` renders `<RuleActionsButtons promRule={rule} groupIdentifier={groupIdentifier} compact />` without passing a `rule` (`RulerRuleDTO`) prop. `AlertRuleMenu` computes `canSilence` from `promRule` via `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` and renders the "Silence notifications" menu item, which sets `showSilenceDrawer(true)` on click. However, line 104 still guards `<SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer>` with `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`, which is always `false` when `rule` is `undefined`, so clicking "Silence notifications" in the alert list view does nothing.

findings.title: Delete and Pause menu items are still gated on `rulerRule`, preventing them from rendering in the alert list view
findings.body: `AlertRuleMenu` now computes `canDelete` and `canPause` using `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(promRule, ...)` for the alert list view where `rulerRule` is no longer fetched. However, rendering the Delete item on line 165 still checks `{canDelete && rulerRule && ...}` and rendering the Pause item on line 123 still checks `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. Because `GrafanaRuleListItem` only passes `promRule` (leaving `rulerRule` as `undefined`), neither Delete nor Pause is ever rendered for Grafana rules in the list view (even though `RuleActionsButtons.V2` already passes a `handleDelete` callback that only requires `identifier` and `groupIdentifier`). In addition, `canPause` being `true` while the Pause item is not rendered can cause `showDivider` on line 119 to render a leading `<Menu.Divider />` with no items above it.

findings.title: Missing `key` prop on `GrafanaRuleListItem` when mapping filtered rules
findings.body: When replacing `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} ... />` with `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` inside `rules.map(...)`, the `key={key}` prop was removed. Rendering list items in an array without a `key` prop triggers React key warnings and can lead to incorrect component state reuse when the filtered list updates.

findings.title: `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` marks `ModifyExport`, `Pause`, `Restore`, and `DeletePermanently` as unsupported for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: In `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule` is `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)`, which is `true` for both Grafana alerting rules and Grafana recording rules. In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, `isAlertingRule` is computed with `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` (which is `false` for `GrafanaPromRecordingRuleDTO`) and used as the support flag for `ModifyExport`, `Pause`, `Restore`, and `DeletePermanently` on lines 324-330. As a result, Grafana-managed recording rules will no longer support exporting or pausing when abilities are evaluated from `GrafanaPromRuleDTO`.

findings.title: Refactoring `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` drops the federated rule group immutability check
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule)` previously checked `const isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` so that rules in federated rule groups were treated as immutable (`Update` and `Delete` unsupported). It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule.rulerRule, groupIdentifierV2)`, which hardcodes `const isFederated = false` on line 245, allowing edit and delete actions on federated rule groups for callers of `useAlertRuleAbility` and `useAlertRuleAbilities`.
